title: Building – Bedroom Windows – October 2019
description: A homeowner's 2013 renovation deviated from the permit drawings, leaving a bedroom with windows lacking the minimum openable area for egress in an unsprinklered house. The municipality ordered the window changed and re-inspected.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an s.49 order

outcome_summary: Order confirmed: the owner bears the compliance duty and no exception applies. Expired timelines were not extended.
